Welcome to **Vyntric**!

To gain access to all channels, view the community, and participate in discussions, you must complete member verification.

📋 **How to verify:**
React with the **✅** emoji below to verify and unlock full access to the server.

*(No links, buttons, or external authorizations needed — simply react with ✅ below!)*

📌 **Rules & Guidelines:**
• Follow the official [Discord Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms) & [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines).
• Be respectful to all members and staff. Zero tolerance for harassment or hate speech.
• No advertising, unsolicited DMs, spam, or malicious links.
• No NSFW content or disruptive behavior.
